name: Girisopam
summary: Girisopam (GYKI-51189, EGIS-5810) is a drug which is a 2,3-benzodiazepine derivative related to tofisopam and zometapine. It has a selective anxiolytic action with no sedative, anticonvulsant or muscle relaxant effects.
